references.text: Akira, son of Enan, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Naphtali in the census taken in the wilderness.
Akira, son of Enan, was appointed as the leader of the tribe of Naphtali in the camp arrangement.
Akira, son of Enan, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Naphtali at the dedication of the altar.
Naphtali was a son of Jacob and Bilhah, and became the ancestor of the tribe of Naphtali.
Jacob's blessing over Naphtali, the ancestor of the tribe that Akira led.
